description: Foundation: TenantMetaApp schema + idempotent Turso migration script + shared resolveMetaAppCredentials resolver. This is the base every consumer in FEAT-002 depends on. Grounded in prisma/schema.prisma (sqlite provider, UserCredits/WhatsAppNumber conventions), scripts/add-meta-onboarding-columns.mjs (proven migration pattern), src/lib/crypto.ts (encrypt/decrypt) and src/lib/db.ts (prisma default export). Must be built first; FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 depend on it.
steps: In prisma/schema.prisma add the TenantMetaApp model exactly per design §1: id String @id @default(cuid()); userId String @unique; user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade); metaAppId String (plaintext); metaAppSecret String (AES-256-GCM ciphertext); configId String?; createdAt DateTime @default(now()); updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt. Keep datasource provider = "sqlite". Do NOT run `prisma db push`.
Add the back-relation `tenantMetaApp TenantMetaApp?` to the User model alongside existing relations (credits, whatsappNumbers, templates, etc.).

Create scripts/add-tenant-meta-app-table.mjs reusing the mechanics of scripts/add-meta-onboarding-columns.mjs: same manual .env regex parse, createClient({ url: env.TURSO_DATABASE_URL, authToken: env.TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN }), try/catch -> non-secret console.error -> process.exit(1), client.close() in finally.

In that script execute the exact DDL from design §1: `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS TenantMetaApp (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, userId TEXT NOT NULL, metaAppId TEXT NOT NULL, metaAppSecret TEXT NOT NULL, configId TEXT, createdAt TEXT NOT NULL, updatedAt TEXT NOT NULL);` then `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS TenantMetaApp_userId_key ON TenantMetaApp (userId);`. No FOREIGN KEY, no DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP (rationale: libSQL does not enforce FKs without PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON; Prisma supplies all timestamps). Optionally PRAGMA table_info(TenantMetaApp) first to log 'created' vs 'already exists. Skipping.' Log only table/index status, never row data.

Create src/lib/meta-app.ts per design §2: export interface ResolvedMetaApp { appId: string; appSecret: string; configId: string | null; source: 'tenant' | 'platform' }; export class MetaAppConfigError extends Error (default message 'Meta app is not configured', name 'MetaAppConfigError'); export async function resolveMetaAppCredentials(userId: string): Promise<ResolvedMetaApp>. Import prisma from '@/lib/db' and decrypt from '@/lib/crypto'.

Implement precedence in the resolver: const row = await prisma.tenantMetaApp.findUnique({ where: { userId } }); if row, decrypt(row.metaAppSecret) inside try/catch and on throw `throw new MetaAppConfigError('Tenant Meta app credentials are invalid')` (never rethrow/log the caught error), return { appId: row.metaAppId, appSecret, configId: row.configId ?? null, source: 'tenant' }; else read process.env.META_APP_ID/META_APP_SECRET, if either falsy throw new MetaAppConfigError('Server is not configured for Embedded Signup'), return { appId, appSecret, configId: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_META_CONFIG_ID ?? null, source: 'platform' }. The resolver never logs; the ciphertext row stays local and is never returned.
acceptance_criteria: prisma/schema.prisma contains the TenantMetaApp model and User.tenantMetaApp back-relation; `npx prisma validate` reports the schema is valid and `npx prisma generate` exposes prisma.tenantMetaApp (confirmed by the build compiling code that references it).

scripts/add-tenant-meta-app-table.mjs creates the table with CREATE TABLE/INDEX IF NOT EXISTS, columns matching the model exactly (id,userId,metaAppId,metaAppSecret,configId,createdAt,updatedAt) plus the TenantMetaApp_userId_key unique index, with no FOREIGN KEY and no DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP; a second run is a clean no-op.

resolveMetaAppCredentials returns source:'tenant' with decrypted appSecret when a row exists, source:'platform' with env values when it does not; a tampered/undecryptable tenant secret yields MetaAppConfigError with no secret/ciphertext in the message; missing platform META_APP_ID/META_APP_SECRET yields MetaAppConfigError('Server is not configured for Embedded Signup').
verification: Run `npm run build` (= prisma generate && next build) and confirm it completes with no type errors and the generated client exposes prisma.tenantMetaApp.

Run `node scripts/add-tenant-meta-app-table.mjs` once (table created, exit 0), then a second time (clean no-op, exit 0, no error); confirm via PRAGMA table_info(TenantMetaApp) the columns and the TenantMetaApp_userId_key index. If TURSO_DATABASE_URL/TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN are unavailable in this environment, state that and verify the DDL + IF NOT EXISTS idempotency by code review.
Reason through the design §2 error-handling/precedence table for the four resolver cases (tenant decrypt; bad decrypt; platform env present; platform env missing).
findings:
DONE. FEAT-002 consumers can import from these exact surfaces.

=== src/lib/meta-app.ts (exact exports) ===
- interface ResolvedMetaApp { appId: string; appSecret: string; configId: string | null; source: 'tenant' | 'platform' }
- class MetaAppConfigError extends Error (constructor(message = 'Meta app is not configured'); name === 'MetaAppConfigError'). Thrown messages used: 'Tenant Meta app credentials are invalid' (bad decrypt) and 'Server is not configured for Embedded Signup' (missing platform env).
- async function resolveMetaAppCredentials(userId: string): Promise<ResolvedMetaApp>
Import style: `import { resolveMetaAppCredentials, MetaAppConfigError } from '@/lib/meta-app'`. Module imports prisma (default) from '@/lib/db' and { decrypt } from '@/lib/crypto'. Resolver NEVER logs; ciphertext stays local, only decrypted secret returned. On DB error from findUnique it does NOT catch — propagates to caller's top-level try/catch.

Precedence (verified vs design §2): tenant row -> decrypt (bad decrypt => MetaAppConfigError, no leak); no row -> process.env.META_APP_ID/META_APP_SECRET (either falsy => MetaAppConfigError('Server is not configured for Embedded Signup')); platform configId = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_META_CONFIG_ID ?? null.

=== prisma/schema.prisma ===
- Added model TenantMetaApp { id @id @default(cuid()); userId @unique; user User @relation(onDelete: Cascade); metaAppId String (plaintext); metaAppSecret String (AES-256-GCM ciphertext); configId String?; createdAt @default(now()); updatedAt @updatedAt }.
- Added User back-relation: `tenantMetaApp TenantMetaApp?`.
- `npm run build` (prisma generate && next build) passed exit 0 => prisma.tenantMetaApp client accessor is available and type-checks. (Note: `npx prisma validate` cannot run in this env because the datasource URL is libsql:// not file:// (P1012) — expected environment constraint; build is the authoritative check.)

=== scripts/add-tenant-meta-app-table.mjs ===
- CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS TenantMetaApp (id/userId/metaAppId/metaAppSecret TEXT NOT NULL, configId TEXT, createdAt/updatedAt TEXT NOT NULL) + CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS TenantMetaApp_userId_key ON TenantMetaApp(userId). No FOREIGN KEY, no DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP.
- MIGRATION RUN OUTCOME: TURSO_DATABASE_URL/TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN were available. Run 1 => 'TenantMetaApp table created.' exit 0. Run 2 => 'TenantMetaApp table already exists. Skipping.' exit 0 (clean no-op). PRAGMA table_info confirmed columns: id:TEXT NOTNULL PK, userId:TEXT NOTNULL, metaAppId:TEXT NOTNULL, metaAppSecret:TEXT NOTNULL, configId:TEXT, createdAt:TEXT NOTNULL, updatedAt:TEXT NOTNULL. PRAGMA index_list confirmed TenantMetaApp_userId_key (unique). The table is LIVE on Turso now.

=== Note for FEAT-002 webhook ===
Webhook §4 reads TenantMetaApp.metaAppSecret directly and decrypts (does NOT call resolveMetaAppCredentials) to keep 'skip bad candidate' semantics. WhatsAppNumber.phoneNumberId remains unindexed (out of scope).
